FALSIFY-GPUTRAIN-005.assessment: 15× safety margin under the 500 ms/step floor on RTX 4090 for 370M at spec-canonical batch=1 seq=2048. Comfortable PASS.

FALSIFY-GPUTRAIN-006.root_cause_hypothesis: CUDA floating-point non-determinism — cuBLAS GEMM algorithm selection depends on runtime heuristics (workspace size, recent shape cache), atomic reductions in gradient accumulation order by thread scheduling, cuDNN fall-through to non-deterministic algorithms. Observed |Δ| at step 0 (pure forward pass, no training update) confirms the drift originates in matmul/softmax kernels, not in gradient aggregation.
FALSIFY-GPUTRAIN-006.assessment: Full runtime discharge of GPUTRAIN-006 blocks on explicit CUDA deterministic mode wiring (cublasSetMathMode CUBLAS_PEDANTIC_MATH, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, cuDNN determinism flag, atomics-off reductions). Current CudaTransformerTrainer does NOT enable deterministic mode because it costs ~15-30% throughput. Remains PARTIAL_ALGORITHM_LEVEL — the algorithm-level verdict fn is provably correct, but runtime CUDA determinism requires a separate code path not yet written.
FALSIFY-GPUTRAIN-006.follow_up: File ticket: 'CUDA deterministic mode for CudaTransformerTrainer — opt-in flag that wires cublasSetMathMode(PEDANTIC) + CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG + cuDNN determinism'. Estimate: 1-2 days Rust. Acceptance: re-run GPUTRAIN-006 harness with --deterministic flag, observe max |Δ train_loss| ≤ 1e-5.
